result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one restaurant card image failed to load (showing a broken-image placeholder), and the horizontally scrolling restaurant list truncates a card title at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' shows a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant photo, making the card look broken and unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source or add a graceful fallback (e.g., a branded placeholder image or restaurant logo) so the card never displays a raw broken-image icon.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with the title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator, which can look like a layout glitch rather than an intentional carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll affordance (peeking card with consistent padding, edge fade, or pagination dots) and ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis so the cutoff reads as intentional.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', ...) also has a partially visible chip cut off at the right edge with no scroll hint, mirroring the carousel truncation issue.
issues.suggestion: Provide a visual cue that the chip list is horizontally scrollable, such as an edge gradient fade or slight peek of the next chip.
